entities.summary: Puerto Cabezas is a municipality and city in Nicaragua. It is the capital of Miskito nation in the North Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region. Puerto Cabezas is a big city, established around 1929-02-12. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
